question: For each administrative department in the School of Engineering corresponding to the Mechanical Engineering department, list the administrative department name, department code, minimum CIP program code, total number of degree-granting departments for courses, and the total number of such courses per administrative department. Additionally, for each such department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all degree-granting departments (excluding Biology), and indicate whether the department's coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE', 'BELOW_AVERAGE', or 'AVERAGE' compared to the overall average. Present the results in the order of administrative department name and department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DepartmentVariation AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.coefficient_of_variation, avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < avg_cv.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte ) avg_cv ), EngineeringMechEngDept AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.min_cip_program_code, inner_cte.total_departments, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) AS Total_Courses ON inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT emd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, emd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, emd.min_cip_program_code, emd.total_departments, emd.Total_Courses, dv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dv.coefficient_of_variation, dv.avg_coefficient_of_variation, dv.variation_category FROM EngineeringMechEngDept emd JOIN DepartmentVariation dv ON emd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY emd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, emd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
column_mapping: {"administrative department name": ["SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "department code": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE"], "minimum CIP program code": ["SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE"], "total number of degree-granting departments for courses": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE"], "total number of such courses per administrative department": ["SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE"], "department name": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "coefficient of variation of the total units of subjects offered by that department in the 2024 academic year": ["COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS", "SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE", "COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR"], "average coefficient of variation across all degree-granting departments (excluding Biology)": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE", "COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS"], "variation category": []}
